chunks: You should say: Peace be upon you, O Guardian of Allah; Peace be upon you, O Proof of Allah; Peace be upon you, O Caliph of Allah; Peace be upon you, O Pillar of the Religion; Peace be upon you, O Inheritor of the Prophets; Peace be upon you, O Distributor of Paradise and Hell, and Owner of the Staff and the Branding Tool; Peace be upon you, O Amir al-Mu'minin.

I testify that you are the Word of Piety, the Door of Guidance, the Firmest Handle, the Strong Rope, and the Straight Path. And I testify that you are the Proof of Allah upon His creation, His witness upon His servants, His trustee over His knowledge, the Keeper of His secret, the place of His wisdom, and the brother of His Messenger (peace be upon him).

And I testify that your call is true, and every caller set up besides you is false and repelled. You are the first oppressed one, and the first whose right was usurped, so you were patient and reckoned. May Allah curse those who oppressed you and exceeded against you and turned away from you with a great curse, by which every near Angel, every sent Prophet, and every tested believing servant curse them.

May Allah send blessings upon you, O Amir al-Mu'minin, and may Allah send blessings upon your soul and body. I testify that you are the servant of Allah and His trustee; you delivered while advising, fulfilled while being trusted, were killed as a truthful one, and departed upon certainty. You did not prefer blindness over guidance, nor incline from truth to falsehood.

I testify that you established Salat, paid Zakat, enjoined good, forbade evil, followed the Messenger, advised the community, recited the Book with its true recitation, struggled in Allah's way as it was rightful, and called to His way with wisdom and goodly admonition until death (certainty) came to you.

I testify that you were upon clear proof from your Lord, called to Him with insight, delivered what you were commanded, and stood with the right of Allah without weakness or fatigue. So may Allah send upon you a blessing that follows, is continuous, and successive, one following another, with no interruption, no end, and no term. And peace be upon you, and the mercy and blessings of Allah. May Allah recompense you, O Truthful one, with good for your subjects.

I testify that Jihad with you is Jihad, and that Truth is with you and towards you, and you are its people and its mine, and the inheritance of Prophethood is with you. So may Allah send blessings upon you and grant abundant peace; and may Allah punish your killer with various types of punishment.

I have come to you, O Amir al-Mu'minin, knowing your right, perceiving your status, being an enemy to your enemies and a friend to your friends. May my father and mother be sacrificed for you! I have come to you seeking refuge with you from the Fire, which is deserved by one like me due to what I have committed against myself. I have come to you as a visitor, seeking through my visitation the emancipation of my neck from the Fire.

I have come to you fleeing from my sins, which I have loaded upon my back. I have come to you as a delegate due to your great status and position with my Lord. So intercede for me with your Lord, for I have many sins, and indeed you have a known position with Allah, a great status, a great affair, and accepted intercession. And Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has said: 'And they do not intercede except for the one whom He approves of.'

O Allah, Lord of the lords, Helper of the lovers! I have sought refuge with the brother of your Messenger with a refuge, so free my neck from the Fire. I believed in Allah and what was revealed to you, and I befriended the last of you as I befriended the first of you, and I rejected Al-Jibt and Al-Taghut, and Al-Lat and Al-Uzza.
ai.seo_question: What are the key titles and virtues of Imam Ali mentioned in the Dua at his grave?
ai.summary: This supplication, recorded in *Al-Kafi*, serves as a cornerstone of Shia devotional practice, emphasizing Imam Ali’s (AS) unique ontological status as the 'Proof of Allah' (Hujjatullah) and the inheritor of prophetic wisdom. It integrates theological testimony with personal supplication, highlighting the concept of *Tawassul* (seeking intercession) through the Imam’s accepted status, while affirming his fidelity in delivering the divine message without distortion.
